turns.text: Use the full film pipeline: a 30-second short film styled as a video podcast, with both hosts on screen speaking their lines at microphones in a cosy studio. It ends on a friendly disagreement between them.

style.prompt: Create a complete 30-second short film for YouTube, a live-action photorealistic video podcast for a general audience. Two fictional adult economist hosts sit together across a small round walnut table in a cosy professional podcast studio: Maya, a woman in her 30s with dark shoulder-length hair and a teal sweater, sits on the LEFT; Leo, a man in his 30s with short brown hair and a rust-colored casual shirt, sits on the RIGHT. Each has their own black broadcast microphone on an articulated boom arm, positioned below mouth level so their lips remain clearly visible, and studio headphones. Warm amber practical lamps, bookshelves, soft acoustic panels, natural skin texture, realistic cinematic lighting. Landscape 16:9. Both hosts remain clearly on screen throughout in a single continuous stable medium-wide two-shot at eye level, gentle almost imperceptible push-in. No cuts, no montage, no narration, no text, no graphics, no subtitles. Consistent faces, clothing, microphones and room throughout. They discuss economics respectfully, not angrily. CRITICAL AUDIO AND PERFORMANCE: generate clear intelligible English dialogue with two distinct natural voices, Maya's warm female voice and Leo's relaxed male voice. Alternate exactly four speaking turns in the order below. Only the current speaker moves their mouth; the other listens with natural attentive expression and small nods. No simultaneous speech. Accurately synchronize visible lip movements to each speaker's own words. Quiet studio room tone only, no music. Timing: 0-8 seconds Maya says, 'In a recession, households stop spending. Government spending can restore demand and get people working again.' 8-17 seconds Leo says, 'But cheap money and government spending fuel unsustainable booms. Let prices adjust so the economy can recover.' 17-23 seconds Maya says, 'That adjustment can hurt. I’d support demand while people rebuild.' 23-29 seconds Leo says, 'And I’d let markets correct. Same goal, different prescription, Maya!' Final second both smile warmly at one another in friendly disagreement. Maya represents Keynesian economics, Leo represents Austrian-school economics. Dialogue delivery conversational and brisk but clear. Fit all four complete lines within 30 seconds with no truncated ending.
